new_value: {"notes":"Rust now enforces RFC 6550 Path Sequence freshness independently of authenticated 64-bit DAO origin freshness, so older/incomparable snapshots cannot advance durable replay high-water or mutate routes. Added production equal-copy deadline/high-water, changed-equal/older atomic rejection, /128 rejection, and concurrent complete-snapshot replacement regressions. Green: focused rpl_route_state_vectors 4/4; full lichen-rpl and lichen-node suites; std all-target Clippy -D warnings; no-default check/Clippy; targeted rustfmt/diff checks."}
